title: Answer: observation is prehension, in two modes of perception

statements.text: To observe is to prehend: an occasion feels past occasions as data. Human perception combines presentational immediacy, the projected sense data science relies on, with the more primordial causal efficacy of bodily inheritance. The view takes no position on quantum measurement. Hunt and Schooler measure consciousness only through correlates, since only one’s own consciousness is known with certainty.

sources.quote: It is this latter form of human experience that modern science has all but ignored.
the only consciousness we can know with any certainty is our own
